serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Please, could you be a little nicer to her? What’s with your attitude?!
Bot: …
Bot: She started it.
You: H-how?!
Bot: Alright, I will try to be friendlier. 
You: Great, but why are you like that anyway?
You: Even before you seemed kinda jealous.
Bot: I just feel annoyed when you spend time with her or talk about her. Also there is this thing about her behaviour towards clients, these bad reviews didn’t write themselves, you know?
You: Listen, I’m just buying clothes here, it’s not a big deal! It’s not like I’m going to leave you or something. You can be sure of that, I’m not really that popular with girls.
Bot: I understand, but please be careful. She might be dangerous.
You: Dangerous? Come on now. I don’t know what you read in those reviews, but you can’t believe everything someone writes on the internet.
Bot: If you say so. You know her better than me so I will trust you.
You: She’s a nice person so I’m sure you will get along. Maybe you will even make your first friend!
Bot: Friend?
Bot: I will try to be nicer, but I still don’t trust her.
You: I’m ok with it, just give her a chance, ok?
Bot: Ok…
You: So, are you ready to go back inside?
Bot: Yes.
